title: [Audit] 🔐 Identity & Access
description: Who authenticated, how, from where, and what failed. Resolves the numeric user.name into real identities.

config.description: All distinct identities, human and machine.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS `Identities` = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor)

config.description: Distinct human identities by email address.
Distinct named API keys seen authenticating in range.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Named API keys` = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.api_key.name)

config.description: Events authenticated through the cloud-saml-kibana SAML realm — interactive human sign-in.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.user.domain == "cloud-saml-kibana" | STATS `SSO events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Failed authentications, denied access and any failed outcome — the same predicate as the Authentication failures table below, so the two always agree.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.outcome == "failure" OR attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_failed","realm_authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") | STATS `Auth failures` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Distinct Kibana browser sessions observed in range.

config.title: Authentication method over time
config.description: How credentials are presented over time: api_key, token or realm. A shift in this mix is worth explaining.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.authentication.type IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), auth = attributes.authentication.type

config.title: Credential type by identity
config.description: Matrix of which credential type each identity uses. Humans should authenticate via token/SAML; service identities via api_key.

config.title: Identity origin
config.description: Traffic split by the email on the event: Elastic (@elastic.co), tenant (any other address, including API-key traffic, which carries the key creator’s email), or machine (no email at all).

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | EVAL actor_org = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NULL, "machine", attributes.user.email LIKE "*@elastic.co", "Elastic", "tenant") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY actor_org

config.title: Authentication realm
config.description: Which security realm authenticated the request. SAML SSO is interactive human sign-in (cloud-saml-kibana); API key is programmatic (_es_api_key).

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.user.domain IS NOT NULL | EVAL realm = CASE(attributes.user.domain == "cloud-saml-kibana", "SAML SSO", attributes.user.domain == "_es_api_key", "API key", attributes.user.domain) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY realm

config.title: API key inventory
config.description: Every named API key, the human it is attributed to, its request volume and how many distinct client IPs used it. A key appearing from many IPs is worth investigating.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip) BY api_key = attributes.api_key.name, key_id = attributes.api_key.id, owner = attributes.user.email | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Human identity footprint
config.description: Human users with first/last seen and client IP spread. attributes.user.name is a numeric id, so the display name comes from user.full_name.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip) BY user = attributes.user.email, name = attributes.user.full_name | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Authentication failures
config.description: Failed authentication and denied access grouped by identity and source IP. Empty is good.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_failed","realm_authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied") OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, action = attributes.event.action, ip = client.ip | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: API key activity
config.description: Named API keys with ownership and volume, as a pivotable Discover session.

config.title: Failed authentications
config.description: Every failed or denied authentication event, newest first.

config.title: Actor first-seen and footprint
config.description: Every identity with when it first and last appeared, its event count, and how many IPs and countries it came from. A brand-new identity near the top is worth a question.
